placement_vector_schema.transaction_domain: which operations require one atomic commit domain
placement_vector_schema.data_placement: where canonical or derived payload bytes reside
placement_vector_schema.process_domain: same address space vs IPC boundary
placement_vector_schema.fault_domain: which failures can corrupt or stall which state
placement_vector_schema.rebuild_policy: whether and from what lineage state can be reconstructed

result_admission_schema.AUTHORITATIVE_EXACT: may support exact fact/effect decisions subject to current operation checks
result_admission_schema.EXACT_DERIVED: deterministically derived and source-epoch bound; exact for declared transform
result_admission_schema.APPROXIMATE_CANDIDATE: retrieval candidate only; cannot become fact merely by rank
result_admission_schema.SALIENCE_ONLY: accessibility/prior only; neither truth nor workspace selection authority
result_admission_schema.MODEL_INTERNAL_ONLY: reader runtime state; not database truth
result_admission_schema.PROTECTED_EXTERNAL_RESOURCE: reference to resource released only through separate current-policy boundary

closure_states.KNOWN_INVALID: required dependency changed; recompute or reject
closure_states.UNKNOWN: dependency set may be incomplete; broaden, instrument, recompute or defer

promotion_boundary: No physical placement is promoted from U2. Target FRANK traces, real crash/restart, cross-engine equivalence, migration rollback and Linux/Android sustained evidence remain required.
